children: Nexus Capital Investments, Inc. acquired a 79.6% stake in BioForce NanoSciences Holdings, Inc.’s common stock. The investor disclosed the position in a Schedule 13D filed on Sep. 04, 2026, following a private purchase completed on Apr. 22, 2026. The deal involved 26.7 million shares bought for $400,000, giving Nexus effective control and a platform to influence strategy.

Nexus signaled the option to reshape the company’s direction. The firm stated it may pursue mergers or acquisitions and could sell or transfer a material amount of assets as it evaluates opportunities.
Governance changes are on the table. Nexus said it "reserve[s] the right to change the management, the board and their terms" and also to adjust "the capital structure of the Company" over time.

Nexus Capital Investments, Inc. is a Wyoming corporation that invests its own working capital in control and strategic positions. The firm focuses on transactions where it can drive corporate actions and operational change. In this filing, Nexus used internal funds to acquire a majority stake in BioForce NanoSciences Holdings, Inc..
